Home/School Life

School life

Learning that children can touch, move through and remember.

Nature, creative work, mindful moments and shared experiences make ideas real—and help a young child picture themselves as a capable learner.

Experience gallery

Every image should answer: what is the child learning?

This gallery is organised by experience rather than by photo date. Select an image to explore it.

Prototype uses media already supplied in the CAIS project assets. Production publication remains conditional on documented consent for every identifiable child and staff member.

Four kinds of experience

Learning moves between child, classroom, nature and community.

Relationships

Attentive adults add language, ask questions and help children persist without taking over.

Making & inquiry

Open-ended materials turn observation into classification, design, storytelling and problem-solving.

Outdoor learning

Real places make movement, science, vocabulary and care for the environment tangible.

Culture & community

Local places, family participation and shared traditions help learning feel connected to life in Phuket.

Thai culture and place

International learning, grounded in Phuket.

CAIS public updates from its first term show children visiting the Phuket Peranakan Museum, exploring local history and making a traditional Thai dessert. These are useful examples of culture becoming a lived learning experience.

  1. 01
    Meet a real place

    Children encounter objects, people and stories beyond the classroom.

  2. 02
    Use language in context

    New vocabulary connects to something they can see and do.

  3. 03
    Create and participate

    Hands-on activity makes culture active rather than decorative.

  4. 04
    Bring the story back

    Conversation and creative work help children revisit the experience.
